text.p: Alcatel Alsthom should more than double its operating profit in 1997, chairman Serge Tchuruk said on Thursday.
The 1996 operating profit was 2.903 billion francs.
"It is realistic to suppose that the operating profit will more than double in 1997," Tchuruk told a shareholders' meeting.
He also said Alcatel was capable of maintaining the growth in turnover seen during the first quarter throughout the rest of the year.
Sales grew 12.1 percent in the first quarter.
Alcatel expects to see particularly firm growth in telecommunications, Tchuruk said.
He expected Alcatel to remain on track with restructuring plans that call for a full return to health by 1998.
"It is clear that the year 1997 should see the initial progress which we experienced last year being confirmed," Tchuruk said.
